name: Andrew WW
quote: Alex the owner is a very reliable, friendly & helpful man, if you rent from here, you will have a great, hassle-free trip, supported by local knowledge and useful tips. Very highly recommended.

name: Mukkul Gagnani
quote: Excellent conditions of the bike and excellent service provided . Best bike rental here in HCM have been renting with them for a year now zero issues

name: 曽根原功二
quote:
"1年以上借りていました。
            とても良いサービスとクオリティーで、たまに出張で点検に来てくれたり、英語でやり取りできてとても快適でした。
            おススメです。"

name: Douglas Ryan
quote: VietRide has always been dependable and helpful. When I have lost my keys or had other issues, they were immediately on scene to help. My motorbike has always worked perfectly and they take care of all the maintenance. Absolutely superb customer service!

name: 신수연
quote:
여기 사장님은 호주분이신데 한국사람들에게 무척 친절하게 잘해줘요. 오토바이 타고 어디갈지도 알려주고 맛집도 많이 아는 듯 합니다. 호치민에서 진짜 개강추 ㅋㅋㅋ
            영어 콩글리쉬해도 한국사람 하도 많이 받아서 다 알아들으니 걱정안해도 됩니다 😄

name: Damien Willis
quote: Been renting from Vietride for over a year now. Have only had great experiences with Alec and the team. They’re super friendly and accommodating and the bikes are better maintained than other places i’ve rented from. Highly recommended!
